comment: HD graphics (docs/HD-GRAPHICS.md): Peter Johnson's runtime art pack, pinned. Upgrading = changing tag, url, sha256 and size here. tools/fetch_hd_pack.py downloads it, checks this checksum and installs it in data/native/hd (not in the repository); the game's opening window downloads it the same way (src/host/host_launcher.c, built with these values) into the user's own folder.
